en.name: Liquid concentrate or ready-to-feed formula
en.summary: An unopened can or bottle of liquid concentrate or ready-to-feed formula should be discarded after its use-by date. Once opened, it keeps 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered — and a bottle that has been fed from follows the much shorter rule for a started feed.
en.pantry: An unopened can or carton is commercially sterilised and shelf-stable to its use-by date, and after that date it should be discarded rather than judged by eye; no separate pantry figure is given, because the printed date is the manufacturer's own statement. Store it somewhere cool and dark, not in a hot car or a sunny cupboard, and discard any can that is dented at the seam, bulging, rusted or leaking. Once opened, it is not a pantry food at all — it goes straight into the fridge.
en.fridge: 2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened, in the original container or a covered jug, kept at the back of the fridge rather than in the door. Cover it tightly: liquid formula takes up fridge odours quickly. This 2-day figure is for the opened container that has not been fed from. A bottle that a baby has actually drunk from is a different matter entirely — saliva from the teat has gone back into the milk, so that feed is finished within the hour and the remainder is thrown away, not returned to the fridge.
en.freezer: Do not freeze liquid formula. No freezer timeline is published for it, and freezing separates the fat and protein so it will not reconstitute evenly again — which matters when it may be the baby's entire nutrition. Buy the size of container you will use within a couple of days rather than trying to preserve a large one.
spoilage: A can that is bulging, leaking, rusted or dented along a seam — discard unopened.
A sour or off smell, or milk that has curdled or separated.
Lumps or graininess in what should be a smooth liquid.
Any container left out of the fridge and standing at room temperature.
tips: Buy the container size you will finish within the window rather than the biggest.
Write the date and time on the container the moment you open it.
Keep it covered at the back of the fridge, never in the door.
Never add honey to a bottle for a baby under one year old — honey can carry the spores that cause infant botulism.

faq.q: How long does opened ready-to-feed formula keep?
faq.a: 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, for a container that has not been fed from.

faq.q: Can you save a bottle the baby did not finish?
faq.a: No. Once the baby has fed from it, saliva has entered the milk; that feed is finished within the hour and the rest is thrown away.
No. Freezing separates the fat and protein and it will not mix back evenly, and no freezer timeline is published for it.

zh.name: 液態濃縮或即飲配方奶
zh.summary: 未開封的液態濃縮或即飲配方奶，過了有效日期就該丟掉。開封後蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 2 天——而已經餵過的奶瓶，適用的是「開始餵之後」那條短得多的規則。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐裝或利樂包經過商業滅菌，在有效日期之前屬於常溫商品；過了日期就丟，不要用眼睛判斷。這裡不另外給常溫期限，因為印製日期就是製造商自己的說法。請放陰涼避光處，不要留在悶熱的車上或曬得到的櫃子裡；罐身接縫凹陷、鼓脹、生鏽或滲漏的，一律丟掉。一旦開封，它就完全不是常溫食品了——請直接放冷藏。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下 2 天，維持在原容器或加蓋的壺裡，放冰箱深處而不是門邊。要蓋緊：液態配方奶很會吸冰箱的味道。這個 2 天是給「已開封但沒有餵過」的容器。寶寶真的喝過的那瓶完全是另一回事——奶嘴上的口水已經回到奶裡，所以那一餐要在一小時內結束，剩下的倒掉，不要放回冰箱。
zh.freezer: 不要冷凍液態配方奶。它沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且冷凍會讓脂肪和蛋白質分離、再也混不回均勻的狀態——當它可能是寶寶全部的營養來源時，這件事很重要。請買你在期限內用得完的容量，而不是想辦法保存一個大罐。
spoilage: 罐身鼓脹、滲漏、生鏽，或接縫處凹陷——不要打開，直接丟掉。
聞起來發酸或有異味，或奶水結塊、分層。
原本該滑順的液體出現顆粒或結塊。
任何離開冰箱、在室溫下擺過的容器。
tips: 買期限內用得完的容量，不要挑最大罐。
開封的當下就在容器上寫下日期和時間。
蓋好放冰箱深處，絕對不要放門邊。
未滿一歲的寶寶，奶瓶裡絕對不能加蜂蜜——蜂蜜可能帶有引起嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒的孢子。

faq.q: 開封的即飲配方奶可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有餵過的容器，蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天。

faq.q: 寶寶沒喝完的那瓶可以留嗎？
faq.a: 不行。只要寶寶喝過，口水就已經進到奶裡；那一餐一小時內結束，剩下的倒掉。

faq.q: 液態配方奶可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 不行。冷凍會讓脂肪和蛋白質分離、再也混不回去，而且它也沒有公布的冷凍期限。
